Paychex Flex Retirement Services: Simplify Plan Management

Managing a workplace retirement plan doesn’t have to be complicated. In this video, you’ll learn how Paychex Flex Retirement Services helps businesses streamline retirement plan administration, supports employee financial wellness, and helps simplify compliance. Explore available retirement plan options including 401(k) plans, Pooled Employer Plans (PEPs), SIMPLE IRAs, and more. See how payroll integration automatically updates employee contributions, simplifies deductions, giving employees an easier way to manage their savings. With an intuitive dashboard and expert guidance built in, Paychex helps employers save time and employees build a stronger financial future.

0:39 Our retirement dashboard is your one stop shop for a holistic view of your plans, simplifying maintenance and reporting.

Payroll and Retirement Integration
